_comment: CUTOVER CONFIG — not active. Replaces vercel.json at go-live:
cp vercel.cutover.json vercel.json && git commit && git push
What it does: every request to buima-tracker.vercel.app is redirected to
tools.buimaenergy.com, keeping the path. This is what makes the cutover
seamless rather than a race — once it is live, NOTHING can write to
Supabase any more, because there is no longer a reachable UI pointing at
it. The final migration re-run after this point is therefore guaranteed
complete, instead of hoping nobody uploaded in the meantime.
Share links are the reason the path is preserved. The migration kept every
share_token unchanged, so
buima-tracker.vercel.app/share/<token>
-> tools.buimaenergy.com/share/<token>
is the same site for the same customer. Investors' existing links keep
working and nothing has to be reissued.
308 (permanent) rather than 302: it is cacheable and browsers keep the
method, and we do intend this to be permanent. If a rollback is ever
needed, restore the old vercel.json — but note that browsers and proxies
will have cached the 308, so a rollback is not instant for someone who
already followed it. Roll back by pointing DNS, not by editing this file.
redirects run BEFORE rewrites in Vercel, so the SPA catch-all below never
sees these requests.
